prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore. It un-deletes the episode with its cuts at its old place, clamped to the end if the project has fewer episodes now, and renumbers the rest 1..n. Non-members, unknown ids and deleted projects get 404. Restoring an episode that isn't deleted changes nothing. The delete message on the Episodes page now has an Undo button, in both languages. To support it I added an optional action button to the toast component. I also moved the previously hardcoded "Episode deleted" text into the message files. Backend tests pass (13) and tsc is clean. eslint reports only issues that were already in the two frontend files I touched.

+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models import Episode, StoryCut
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+URL = "/api/v1/episodes"
+
+
+def make_episode(client, h, order=1, title="Pilot"):
+    pid = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "P", "genres": []}).json()["id"]
+    return pid, make_in(client, h, pid, order, title)
+
+
+def make_in(client, h, pid, order, title):
+    r = client.post(URL, headers=h, json={"title": title, "project_id": pid, "episode_order": order, "story_summary": "sum"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def listing(client, h, pid):
+    return client.get(f"{URL}?project_id={pid}", headers=h).json()
+
+
+def add_cuts(eid):
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        for i, text in [(2, "second"), (1, "first")]:
+            s.add(StoryCut(
+                episode_id=eid, cut_order=i, script=text, selected_layout="full", aspect_ratio="1:1",
+                image_path=f"cuts/{i}.png", dialogues=[{"speaker": "A", "text": text}],
+                appearing_characters=[{"id": "x", "name": "A"}],
+            ))
+        s.commit()
+
+
+def cuts_of(eid):
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        return s.exec(select(StoryCut).where(StoryCut.episode_id == eid).order_by(StoryCut.cut_order)).all()
+
+
+def test_duplicate_copies_episode_and_cuts(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, eid = make_episode(client, h)
+    make_in(client, h, pid, 2, "Other")
+    add_cuts(eid)
+    credits = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+
+    r = client.post(f"{URL}/{eid}/duplicate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    body = r.json()
+    assert body["id"] != eid
+    assert body["title"] != "Pilot" and "Pilot" in body["title"]
+    assert body["story_summary"] == "sum"
+    assert body["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert [(e["title"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listing(client, h, pid)] == [
+        ("Pilot", 1), (body["title"], 2), ("Other", 3)]
+    new_id = body["id"]
+    old, new = cuts_of(eid), cuts_of(new_id)
+    assert [(c.cut_order, c.script, c.image_path, c.dialogues, c.appearing_characters) for c in new] == \
+           [(c.cut_order, c.script, c.image_path, c.dialogues, c.appearing_characters) for c in old]
+    assert {c.id for c in new}.isdisjoint({c.id for c in old})
+    assert client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"] == credits
+
+
+def test_copies_are_independent(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, eid = make_episode(client, h)
+    add_cuts(eid)
+    new_id = client.post(f"{URL}/{eid}/duplicate", headers=h).json()["id"]
+
+    client.put(f"{URL}/{new_id}", headers=h, json={"title": "Changed"})
+    assert client.get(f"{URL}/{eid}", headers=h).json()["title"] == "Pilot"
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        c = cuts_of(new_id)[0]
+        c.dialogues = [{"speaker": "B", "text": "edited"}]
+        s.add(c)
+        s.commit()
+    assert cuts_of(eid)[0].dialogues[0]["speaker"] == "A"
+
+    assert client.delete(f"{URL}/{new_id}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert client.get(f"{URL}/{eid}", headers=h).status_code == 200
+    assert len(cuts_of(eid)) == 2
+
+
+def test_non_member_gets_404(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _, eid = make_episode(client, h)
+    add_cuts(eid)
+    other = signup(client, email="other@example.com")
+    assert client.post(f"{URL}/{eid}/duplicate", headers=other).status_code == 404
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        assert len(s.exec(select(Episode)).all()) == 1
+
+
+def test_missing_or_deleted_episode_is_404(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _, eid = make_episode(client, h)
+    client.delete(f"{URL}/{eid}", headers=h)
+    assert client.post(f"{URL}/{eid}/duplicate", headers=h).status_code == 404
+    assert client.post(f"{URL}/{'0' * 8}-0000-0000-0000-{'0' * 12}/duplicate", headers=h).status_code == 404
+    assert client.post(f"{URL}/{eid}/duplicate").status_code == 401
+
+
+def test_delete_closes_the_gap(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, a = make_episode(client, h, 1, "A")
+    b = make_in(client, h, pid, 2, "B")
+    make_in(client, h, pid, 3, "C")
+    client.delete(f"{URL}/{b}", headers=h)
+    assert [(e["title"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listing(client, h, pid)] == [("A", 1), ("C", 2)]
+
+
+def test_duplicate_in_the_middle_and_repeated(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, a = make_episode(client, h, 1, "A")
+    make_in(client, h, pid, 2, "B")
+    r = client.post(f"{URL}/{a}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    client.post(f"{URL}/{r['id']}/duplicate", headers=h)
+    eps = listing(client, h, pid)
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in eps] == [1, 2, 3, 4]
+    assert eps[0]["title"] == "A" and eps[3]["title"] == "B"
+
+
+def test_create_keeps_numbering_gap_free(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, _ = make_episode(client, h, 1, "A")
+    make_in(client, h, pid, 1, "B")
+    make_in(client, h, pid, 9, "C")
+    assert [(e["title"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listing(client, h, pid)] == [("B", 1), ("A", 2), ("C", 3)]
+
+
+def test_restore_puts_episode_back_with_cuts(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, a = make_episode(client, h, 1, "A")
+    b = make_in(client, h, pid, 2, "B")
+    make_in(client, h, pid, 3, "C")
+    add_cuts(b)
+    client.delete(f"{URL}/{b}", headers=h)
+    r = client.post(f"{URL}/{b}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json()["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert [(e["title"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listing(client, h, pid)] == [("A", 1), ("B", 2), ("C", 3)]
+    assert [c.script for c in cuts_of(b)] == ["first", "second"]
+    # restoring a live episode changes nothing
+    assert client.post(f"{URL}/{b}/restore", headers=h).status_code == 200
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in listing(client, h, pid)] == [1, 2, 3]
+
+
+def test_restore_last_and_first_positions(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, a = make_episode(client, h, 1, "A")
+    b = make_in(client, h, pid, 2, "B")
+    client.delete(f"{URL}/{b}", headers=h)
+    client.delete(f"{URL}/{a}", headers=h)
+    client.post(f"{URL}/{a}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert [(e["title"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listing(client, h, pid)] == [("A", 1)]
+    client.post(f"{URL}/{b}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert [(e["title"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listing(client, h, pid)] == [("A", 1), ("B", 2)]
+
+
+def test_restore_non_member_or_unknown_is_404(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _, eid = make_episode(client, h)
+    client.delete(f"{URL}/{eid}", headers=h)
+    other = signup(client, email="other@example.com")
+    assert client.post(f"{URL}/{eid}/restore", headers=other).status_code == 404
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        assert s.get(Episode, __import__("uuid").UUID(eid)).deleted_at is not None
+    assert client.post(f"{URL}/{'0' * 8}-0000-0000-0000-{'0' * 12}/restore", headers=h).status_code == 404
+    assert client.post(f"{URL}/{eid}/restore").status_code == 401
